ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Jupiter

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between money and romance. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your image and family. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between friendships and money. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your career and your image. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between relationships and your career. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between romance and intimacy. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between family and relationships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The square between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between conversations and routine. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.
